subject: Hospitality
title: Revenue Per Available Seat Hour
description: A 60-second lesson on Revenue Per Available Seat Hour.

hook.text: RevPASH—Revenue Per Available Seat Hour—measures how much money each seat earns per hour. It's the restaurant's version of RevPAR.

buildup.text: A 100-seat restaurant open for 10 hours has 1,000 available seat hours. If it earns $15,000, its RevPASH is $15.

discovery.text: Increasing RevPASH doesn't mean cramming in more guests. Faster table turns, higher check averages.

twist.text: Some tables have wildly different RevPASH. A romantic corner seat turned once earns far less than a bar-top turned four times.

climax.text: Smart operators assign tables based on party size and expected dwell time—maximizing every seat, every hour.

punchline.text: Not all seats are equal. RevPASH reveals which earn and which just sit there.

quiz.question: What does RevPASH measure?
options: Revenue per available seat hour—how much each seat earns per hour
